fields.label: Host Discovery
fields.description: Latest read-only inventory of the VPS itself. Separate from Docker readiness, Bench ownership and lifecycle state.

fields.label: Host Discovery Snapshot
fields.description: Versioned read-only Host inventory, including compute, storage, network, OS, tools and service observations. Contract: docs/migrations/schemas/infrastructure-node-host-discovery-v2.schema.json.

fields.label: Docker Runtime Inspection
fields.description: Latest read-only inspection of the system Docker Engine. Independent of Host-native Node lifecycle state.

fields.label: Inspection Status
fields.options:
Not Inspected
Successful
Partial
Failed
Timed Out
fields.description: Outcome of the latest inspection attempt; separate from Docker workload readiness.

fields.label: Docker Readiness
fields.description: Whether this Node currently satisfies the platform's Docker workload prerequisites.

fields.label: Docker Readiness Evaluation
fields.description: Server-managed output from the Node-level Docker readiness evaluator, including evaluator version, requirements fingerprint, timestamps and diagnostics.

fields.label: Last Inspected On
fields.description: Timestamp of the latest completed or attempted Docker inspection.

fields.label: Docker Inspection Snapshot
fields.description: Versioned, read-only JSON snapshot. Contract: docs/migrations/schemas/infrastructure-node-docker-inspection-v1.schema.json. Inspection history remains in Node Action Log.

fields.label: Docker Host Lifecycle
fields.description: Server-managed lifecycle of the system Docker Engine on this host. Separate from Node/Bench lifecycle and Docker workload readiness.

fields.label: Docker Host State
fields.options:
Not Evaluated
Connection Required
Host Inspection Required
Privilege Setup Required
Docker Inspection Required
Repository Preparation Required
Ready for Install
Engine Ready
Operation In Progress
Reconciliation Required
Failed
fields.description: Server-managed projection. Action eligibility is recomputed from current host evidence and active operations.

fields.label: Docker Host Operation
fields.description: Current or most recent durable coordinator operation reference.

fields.label: Docker Host Management Snapshot
fields.description: Versioned, bounded server-managed lifecycle evidence and diagnostics. Never contains credentials or raw command output.

fields.label: Docker Helper Release
fields.description: A release is assigned independently per Infrastructure Node. Published catalog releases are immutable.

fields.label: Assigned Docker Helper Release
fields.description: The published helper release this node must converge to.

fields.label: Assigned Release Manifest
fields.description: Node-specific deployment manifest derived from its assigned Published Docker Helper Release. Generated when the assignment changes.

fields.label: Release Assessment Status
fields.options:
Not Assessed
Current
Bootstrap Required
Scripts Deployment Required
Upgrade Required
Reconciliation Required
Source Drift
Unknown Release
Failed

fields.label: Release Assessment Snapshot
fields.description: Server-managed assessment evidence including the locally generated expected manifest, deployed script inspection, installation result and post-install verification.

fields.label: SSH Host Alias
fields.description: Optional alias from the administrator-managed OpenSSH configuration used for direct or gateway access.

fields.label: State
